header: Four steps from first import to first live shift
subheadline: Four weeks is the median for a fifty-technician company, measured from the kick-off call to the first morning where nobody prints a job sheet. Nothing below needs a developer on your side.

items.title: Import your sites and assets
items.description: Send whatever you have: a maintenance spreadsheet, a customer list, an export from the old system. We map it and hand back a register you can correct.

items.title: Set your contracts and SLAs
items.description: Response windows, planned visit frequencies and out-of-hours rates go in once per contract, then generate jobs on their own for the rest of the year.

items.title: Run one crew for a week
items.description: Four or five technicians go live first while the rest carry on as before. A week is enough to find the checklist fields nobody actually needed.

items.title: Switch the board over
items.description: The whole team moves on a Monday, with our people on the phone for the first two mornings. The paper process stays available for a fortnight.
